items.claim: Issues panel is blank on a component's index page
Each open story of a file loads and prepares the whole file again and replaces its siblings' loaded stories
Issues section is empty for a trial showing an index page
items.note: duplicate of the first A finding (index page / Issues panel)

items.claim: Focusing a second trial of the routed story writes the first trial's URL params over its knobs
Story hosts table keeps a ref for every trial id it has ever seen
items.note: The ref for a trial is now dropped when its host detaches. Each ref reads the host map live, so a ref someone still holds keeps giving the right answer. No changeset, since a consumer can't see the change.

items.claim: mountWorkshop silently replaces the caller's `changes` and `revision`
items.note: (changeset title shortened in 5e5f36380b). It now uses the caller's `changes`, and counts the caller's `revision` together with its own, which `revise()` bumps.

items.claim: Two folders at the same path in the sidebar open and close together
items.note: In the Components view, a folder's fold is now stored by library plus path, the same way its row id is built. A reveal opens the folders actually above the target and scrolls to the right row. The split that brought StoryTree back under the function size cap is in 25dc1f64bf.
